headerEntries: The medusa's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 13}). The medusa can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Petrifying Gaze
entries: When une créature that can see the medusa's eyes starts its turn within 30 mètres of the medusa, the medusa can force it to make a {@dd 14}jet de sauvegarde Constitution if the medusa isn't {@conditionincapacité} and can see la créature. Si  saving throw fails by 5 or more, la créature is instantly {@condition pétrifié}. Otherwise, une créature that fails the save begins to turn to metal, wood, or porcelain (the medusa's choice) and is {@condition entravé}. The {@condition entravé} creature must repeat the saving throw at la fin de son prochain tour, becoming {@condition pétrifié} on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until la créature is freed by the  {@spell greater restoration} spell or other magic.

Unless {@status surprised}, une créature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If la créature does so, it can't see the medusa until the start of its next turn, lorsque it can avert its eyes again. If la créature looks at the medusa in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.
Si  medusa sees itself reflected on a polished surface within 30 mètres of it and in an area of bright light, the medusa is, due to its curse, affected by its own gaze.

The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
